title: 4chan whistleblower: fewer bodies found in crashed craft

tellings.quote: Um and so now he's like we see he's like we see a lot less bodies in these crafts.

plain: The YouTuber Chris Ramsay passes on a claim from an anonymous self-described insider who posted on 4chan, an anonymous online message board, that crashed craft recovered in recent years contain a lot fewer bodies than before. Ramsay relays it from the poster's thread, as a hint that whoever flies the craft has changed.
